Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The umpires and the players are out in the middle. The New Zealand players spread out on the field as Kyle Mayers and Shamarh Brooks are all set to open the innings for West Indies. Trent Boult will get proceedings underway with the ball for the Kiwis.
... The Run Chase ...

Now the target is a huge one and West Indies will need someone to play a special knock if they are to chase this down. New Zealand, on the other hand, will back themselves to defend this. Join us for the exciting run chase in a bit.

For the Windies, the bowling in the second half was yet again a problem. They were really good in most of the first half but later on were taken to the cleaners. Hayden Walsh had a day to forget as he was pounded to all parts and Jason Holder and Obed McCoy were expensive too despite the left-arm seamer taking three wickets. Windies will be really disappointed with their performance with the ball.

A powerful batting performance from the Kiwis. The pair of Glenn Phillips and Daryl Mitchell were brilliant in the second half of the innings and have taken New Zealand to a score that seems a daunting one. The start was not all that great though as they lost Martin Guptill and Kane Williamson quickly. Devon Conway and Glenn Phillips steadied the ship and then the stand between Mitchell and Philips has probably batted the Windies out of the game. From a position of trouble, the visitors are in pole position now.

Bye! This is banged in short and over middle, Bracewell looks to take it on as the ball flies close to his head but he misses. The batters do manage to scamper through for a bye and New Zealand finish on 215/5!w

FOUR! Nicely done and this is now the highest scoring by a visiting team in a T20I game in the Caribbean. Full and wide, Michael Bracewell just opens the face of the bat and strokes it through cover-point for a boundary.
Gets the yorker in on off stump, James Neesham pushes it out off side for a single.
Leg bye! Full and angling onto the pads, Bracewell misses the flick and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls away as the batters get a leg bye.
Michael Bracewell is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Smart bowling from Romario Shepherd and he gets rid of the set batter but at this stage it doesn't make much of a difference. Daryl Mitchell shuffles a long way across the off stump and exposes the leg stump completely. Shepherd switches to around the wicket and goes pace on, fuller and on leg stump. Mitchell misses the whip and gets knocked over. A brilliant innings though from Mitchell.
On the hips, pulled away powerfully behind square on the leg side. Hayden Walsh in the deep though is lightning quick and keeps it down to a single.
Romario Shepherd (2-0-20-0) to bowl the final over and West Indies will have one less fielder patrolling the boundary as they have been penalized for slow over rate.
Gets it spot on this time around, full and wide, Neesham reaches out and plays it through covers for jst a single.
WIDE! Smith looks to go full and wide but this is a bit too wide for the umpire's liking.
Full and on the pads, Mitchell clips it through mid-wicket for one more.

Hard length again from Smith, angling across the left-hander. James Neesham tries to stay back and lift it over long off but mistimes it badly towards mid off. Yet another single then for the batters.
On a hard length and outside off, this is punched through covers for just another single.
Full and on middle, Neesham thumps it down to long on for just a single though.

FOUR! Dreadful fielding from Shimron Hetmyer and it has cost his team a boundary. Smith bowls it shorter and on middle Neesham pulls it down towards mid-wicket where Hetmyer attacks the ball but lets it through. The ball trickles away into the fence.
SIX! Excellent ball striking from Daryl Mitchell! Full and angling across the off stump, Mitchell stands well outside the crease and reaches out to clobber it over the long on fence for a maximum.

Leg bye! Another slower one, bowled into the deck and over middle. Neesham tries to play it off the back foot but misses. The ball goes off his body and rolls onto the off side as the batters get a leg bye.
Nicely bowled! Slower delivery, bowled into the pitch and outside off. James Neesham looks to pull but is undone by the lack of pace.
Full and straight, blocked out back towards the bowler.
James Neesham is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Finally, some respite for West Indies and Glenn Phillips departs after a wonderful knock. On a good length, pace on and angling well across the right-hander. Phillips chases it and looks to slap it over the point fence. The ball goes flat and behind point, straight into the clutches of the fielder at the backward point fence. Rovman Powell makes no mistake and Obed McCoy has the breakthrough yet agin for his side.
Commentary.Howout: c Rovman Powell b Obed McCoy

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Oh, my! That has almost smashed into the commentary box. Served on a length and around off, Glenn Phillips stays deep in his crease and smokes it right back over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Full and at the toes, this is dug out through wide mid on for a run.
This is banged in short and over middle and leg, Glenn Phillips backs away and pulls it aerially towards deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Slower and shorter over middle, Mitchell pulls it down to deep square leg for a single.

SIX! It's just too easy at the moment for the Kiwi batters out there. Gentle-paced delivery, full and on middle, Daryl Mitchell makes a bit of room and hits it hard and flat over the bowler's head for yet another maximum.
WIDE! Attempted slower bouncer, goes well over the batter's head. Wide called.
Full and angling into the pads, Phillips backs away and drives it through covers for one.

DROPPED AND SIX! This is just adding salt to the wounds now. Glenn Phillips shuffles past leg stump and Holder follows him. Phillips forces the big shot but doesn't quite get all of it. The ball goes towards wide long on where Shamarh Brooks spills it over the fence.
Jason Holder is back on.

In the air but lands safely yet again. This is pitched up around off, Daryl Mitchell tries to step out and go big over long off but completely mistimes it. The ball goes wide of mid off and a bit further away as the batters get a couple of runs.
On middle, this is eased through mid on for one more.

Mistimed but falls safely. Full and on off, Daryl Mitchell tries to loft it over the long off fence but the bat turns in his hands. The ball goes on the bounce towards long off and it will only be a single.
SIX! This is brutal from Daryl Mitchell! Cross-seamer from McCoy, in the slot around off. Mitchell just swats it away over the long on fence for a biggie. New Zealand eyeing a score of above 200 now.
Very full and outside off, this is driven down to long off for a run.

FOUR! Mishit from Glenn Phillips but it doesn't matter. This is slower and pitched up around off, Phillips has a go at it but gets it off the toe end of the bat. The ball is lofted well over extra cover and trickles down into the fence.
Obed McCoy (2-0-13-2) is back on.
Excellent placement and they will get two runs. This is s bit shorter and on leg stump, Mitchell works it in front of mid-wicket and races back for two.
On the pads, this is tucked away towards square leg for just a single.

SIX! What a way to bring up the FIFTY! Brilliant innings so far from Glenn Phillips and he is scoring at a very quick rate too. Poor ball though from Walsh, tossed up on leg stump. Phillips just lifts it back over the bowler's head and the ball ends up in the stands.
Nicely bowled! This is looped up, down the leg side, Phillips looks to slog-sweep it away but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Flighted, down the leg side, Mitchell eases it through mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
SIX! Clean strike! Tossed up, on leg stump, Daryl Mitchell steps out and hits through the line of the ball, smoking it over the sightscreen for a biggie.
Hayden Walsh (3-0-39-0) to bowl out here. West Indies need to keep a check on the over-rate here or else they will be penalized towards the end of the innings.
One more! Good length, around off, Mitchell eases it through extra cover and picks up a single.
Hard length, outside off, Phillips opens the face of the bat and guides it past the man at short third man for a single.

SIX! WOW! This is short but just not short enough, around off and sits up nicely for the batter. Glenn Phillips pulls it away over the mid-wicket fence and the ball just flies out of the ground and into the car parking. Jason Holder has to go there and retrieve it.
Switches to over the wicket now and serves it on a good length outside off. Mitchell punches it off the back foot and through covers for a run.
FOUR! Just too straight from Odean Smith and New Zealand get yet another bloundary. Around the hips, pace on and Daryl Mitchell just deflects it fine, the ball goes away into the fine leg fence.
WIDE! Smith tries to bowl it well outside off but spills it beyond the tramline. Wided.
Back of a length, over leg stump. Mitchell plays it off the back foot and in between the fielders at long on and deep mid-wicket to pick up a brace.
Quicker delivery, on a nagging length and on off, Phillips manages to keep it out.
FOUR! Walsh errs in line and pays the price. This is quicker again, but down the leg side, Glenn Phillips pulls it fine and past the man at short fine leg to pick up a boundary.
Quicker and fuller, on middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
On the shorter side and it is the wrong 'un from Walsh, around middle. Mitchell works it leg side and rotates the strike.
Excellent running yet again. Flatter delivery, turning into middle, Mitchell stays back and wrists it past square leg. The batters race back for the second.
Comes from around the wicket and serves a very full ball on the pads, this is clipped away behind square on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Smith drops it a bit short and over leg stump, Daryl Mitchell stands tall and pulls it powerfully into the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Short of a length, on leg stump, Mitchell nudges it down to square leg.
Daryl Mitchell is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Just when Devon Conway was looking in full flow, he departs. Odean Smith continues from around the wicket and serves a fullish delivery, angling into the pads. Conway shuffles past the off stump and gets low, trying to scoop it over short fine leg. Conway misses and gets pinged on the pads. The appeal from the Windies players is turned down but Pooran does review it. No spike on UltraEdge and Ball Tracking comes up with three reds. Odean Smith does the job for his side and gets a crucial wicket.

Review! Yet another big shout LBW but it is turned down yet again and this time Nicholas Pooran does go upstairs. The UltraEdge is checked first and there's no bat involved. Ball Tracking shows that it is hitting middle stump. The on-field decision is reversed and West Indies have a breakthrough.

Leg bye! A huge shout from the bowler for lbw but it is turned down, probably pitching outside leg. Good length, around leg stump and skidding through. The ball thuds the pads of the batter and rolls onto the off side. The batters get another leg bye.
Leg bye! Length again, angling it into the pads, Devon Conway looks to flick but misses. The ball goes off the pads and behind square on the leg side as the batters get a leg bye.
Starts from around the wicket and serves a length ball around off, Conway keeps it out on the off side.
Odean Smith to have a bowl now.
SIX! 20 from the over, a big one for New Zealand! A tad shorter and around off, Phillips rocks back and lofts it over the cover fence for yet another maximum.
Hit hard but just for one. Flatter and outside off, cut away to deep point for one.

FOUR! Deft touch now from Phillips and he is showcasing his full range here. This is flatter and well outside off, Phillip just reaches out and nudges it past short third man for a boundary. Walsh under pressure here.
SIX! BANG! On a length and on middle, Devon Conway gets down on one knee and slog-sweeps it well over the square leg fence for a huge hit.
Sloppy from Nicholas Pooran but it only costs a single. Flighted, around off and this is gently pushed towards covers where Pooran lets it through. The batters get a single.

Just short! Walsh starts from around the wicket and serves a shortish delivery, turning across the off stump. Glenn Phillips rocks back and cuts it aerially towards sweeper cover. The man over there comes in and puts in the dive but can't get there. Two taken.

Drinks break! At the halfway mark now and New Zealand are 85/2 with two set batters at the crease. They will now look to accelerate and eye a score of around 175-180 runs. West Indies bowled well in the Powerplay after an early onslaught from Guptill but have lacked control in the middle phase. They need a wicket or two to get back into the game and restrict the opponent to less than 170 runs. Also, Hayden Walsh is back into the attack.
Length, around off, this is just gently pushed towards covers.
On the shorter side and outside off, Phillips hits it off the back foot and towards sweeper cover for one more.
On the pads, this is flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Superb timing from Devon Conway! This is pitched up around off, Conway just plays a checked lofted drive and the ball sails over the wide long off fence for a maximum.
This is short and wide, Glenn Phillips only manages to cut it straight towards the man at deep point for a single.
WIDE! Looks for the wide yorker but bowls it a bit too wide for the umpire's liking.
Shepherd starts off the new spell with a hard-length delivery, around off. Phillips punches it off the back foot and through extra cover for a couple of runs.

FOUR! Three boundaries in the over and this has ruined Holder's figures. Slower delivery, shorter and over leg stump. Devon Conway with a swivel-pull this time and dispatches it into the square leg fence.
Top delivery from Holder. Nails the yorker at the toes but Phillips manages to jam it out towards long on for a single.
Excellent running! Slower delivery, around middle, Phillips just drops it towards the vacant mid-wicket region and races back for two.
FOUR! Glenn Phillips upping the ante now. Just a tad shorter and wider, Phillips is onto it in a flash as he cuts it up and over backward point for yet another boundary.

FOUR! Powerfully struck but Kyle Mayers has made a mess of it. Full and around off, Glenn Phillips thumps it to the left of the long off fielder and Mayers gets a nice bounce but spills it and the ball touches the ropes.
Fullish length, well outside off and this is slapped away towards sweeper cover for a single.
SIX! Here comes the release shot! This is dragged down by Walsh, on middle. Glenn Phillips gets on the back foot and pulls it high and handsome over the cow corner fence for a maximum.
Another reverse sweep, this time from Devon Conway. On middle, Conway reverses it behind square on the off side for one more.
Length this time, around off, Glenn Phillips mistimes the reverse sweep towards short third man and picks up a single. 50 up now for New Zealand.
On a nagging length and a bit quicker, around off. Phillips eases it towards covers.
On the pads, this is worked 'round the corner for just one this time.
Starts off with a floater on middle stump, Devon Conway works it through mid-wicket and comes back for the second with ease.
Hayden Walsh is into the attack now.
Another tidy over from Holder and New Zealand cannot find the boundaries at the moment. Shorter and over leg stump, this is pulled past square leg for just another single.
Full and angling into middle and leg, Phillips works it in front of mid-wicket and collects a single.

Excellent change up from Jason Holder. This is the leg cutter and Holder floats it up full and outside off. Glenn Phillips looks to cover drive but misses and the fall falls just short of the diving keeper. Might have been an edge on it as well.
This is banged in short and over middle, Conway plays a controlled pull shot through square leg for one.
Around the top of off, Devon Conway first looks to shuffle across the off stump but then adjusts and just chops the ball towards backward point.
On a hard length and outside off, this is played down towards short third man.
Nicely bowled, another slower ball, bowled into the deck and around off. Phillips is beaten all ends up. After the Powerplay, New Zealand are 43/2!
Good length, around off, kept out on the off side.

Uneven bounce on that occasion! Length ball, angling in from around off and this one bounces a bit extra. Conway gets taken aback a bit as he plays it with soft hands towards short man and collects a single.
Phillips tries to back away but McCoy bowls it short and wide. Phillips reaches out and manages to slap it through backward point for a single.
Pitched up, on off stump and driven straight towards mid off.
Good running! Around off, Conway presses forward and pushes it out towards cover for a quick single.
WIDE! An attempted slower delivery, very full and angling down leg, wide called.
Good length again, a bit slower and angled into middle. Phillips watchfully keeps it out.
Shorter and over off, Glenn Phillips pulls it without much timing and in front of square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Length, in that channel around off and shaping away a touch. Glenn Phillips lets it through to the keeper.
This is on the pads, Devon Conway flicks it towards square leg and picks up a quick run.
Back of a length and on off, Conway keeps it out on the off side.
Edged but safe! Holder starts his spell with a good-length delivery, angling across the left-hander. Conway hangs back and pushes at it but gets an outside edge towards gully.
Glenn Phillips is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Is there a faint edge on it? Yes, there is and Obed McCoy is turning the game on its head! McCoy serves this one a bit fuller and on a tighter line around off. The natural angle takes the ball across the batter. Kane Williamson just dangles his bat at it and gets a faint knick. Devon Thomas takes a simple catch behind the sticks and New Zealand are all of a sudden two down inside 4 overs.
Commentary.Howout: c Devon Thomas b Obed McCoy

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Sweetly timed! On a length and slanted well across the right-hander. Kane Williamson stands tall, gets on top of the bounce and times it excellently through covers to get off the mark with a boundary.
Banged in short and it is slower once again. Conway looks to pull but can only manage to mistime it behind square for a single.
Kane Williamson comes in at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Excellently held by Nicholas Pooran and Obed McCoy has the last laugh here. McCoy serves it on a length and around off but it is the slower delivery. Martin Guptill takes it on and has a wild swing across the line. Guptill gets a lot of height on it but the ball goes over mid-wicket. Pooran over there runs back and takes a brilliant catch over his shoulders. Guptill departs after a blistering start.
Commentary.Howout: c Nicholas Pooran b Obed McCoy

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Poor delivery! Tries to go full and wide again but serves a half-volley, Martin Guptill thumps it through extra cover for yet another boundary. New Zealand flying now.
Starts off with a full and wide one, hugging the tramline outside off. Guptill chases this one but can't reach it.
Obed McCoy to bowl now.
Back of a length and on middle, Guptill works it past square leg and collects a single. 15 off the over, a good one for New Zealand.
On the pads, flicked away behind square on the leg side for a couple of runs.
Good comeback from Mayers! This is a sharp short ball, over middle and leg. Guptill looks to take it on but is beaten for pace.
FOUR! Easily done! It's the leg cutter from Mayers this time, on middle. Martin Guptill comes forward and hits through the line of the ball, lifting it back over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Switches to around the wickets now and bowls it fuller on middle. Conway pushes it through mid on for a single.

SIX! Crisply struck! Length ball, on middle and Devon Conway just has a whip at it. Conway picks it up and uses the bottom hand to send the ball sailing with the wind and a long way over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Leg bye! This is bowled around the hips, Devon Conway looks to tuck it away but misses. The ball goes off the thigh pads and towards short fine leg. The batters get a leg bye.
Length again, on off, Conway punches it out on the off side.
Excellent running! Good length, around off, Guptill strokes it through covers. Two fielders chase it down and manage to keep it on. The batters come back for three.
FOUR! Nonchalantly done by Martin Guptill! Hard length, around middle and Guptill just swats it in front of mid-wicket and the ball rockets into the fence for the first boundary of the match.

Risky single but they make it with ease. Just short of a length and outside off, Devon Conway nudges it towards short third man and sets off for the run. The fielder scores a direct hit at the batter's end but Guptill is home.
Shepherd starts off with a good-length ball, around the top of off. Conway just stands tall and pushes it out towards extra cover.
Romario Shepherd to operate from the other end.
A tidy first over from Kyle Mayers, just 4 off it. This is on the pads, Conway tucks it towards mid-wicket and races across for the single.
Quick single! Length, around off and this is just tapped towards covers for a quick run.

Conway trying to be inventive from the get-go. Good length, over middle and leg, Conway shuffles and tries to scoop it over short fine leg. The ball goes off the thigh pads and the batters sneak in a leg bye.
Short again and around off, Conway plays it off the back foot down towards point.
This is a bit shorter and angling across the left-hander. Devon Conway hangs back and dabs it down with soft hands towards backward point.
New Zealand are underway! Mayers starts off with a fullish delivery, wide of the off stump. Martin Guptill reaches out and slashes it towards deep point for a single.

We are ready for play! The umpires and the Windies players out in the middle as the Kiwi openers, Martin Guptill and Devon Conway take guard. Kyle Mayers has been handed the new ball and he is raring to go. Before that, the Windies players take the knee in support of the BLM movement. Let's play...

Rovman Powell is in for a quick chat. Powell says that it's a special feeling to play international cricket in front of your home crowd. Adds that his form is a bit here and there and he's got into the twenties but needs to bat deeper and go on to get a big score. Says that his role is to close games, previously he batted at number 4 but they have had conversations about his best position. Adds that it is important for them to be disciplined with both bat and ball and they lose wickets in clusters which needs to be fixed.

PITCH REPORT - Samuel Badree is pitchside and says it's hot and humid out there. He informs that it's the same strip from the last game. Mentions that there's an even covering of grass and the pitch is hard and there's good bounce and even carry. Adds that there will be an impact of spin and the batters can score big once they settle in.

Nicholas Pooran, the captain of West Indies says that they are going with the same team and informs that Brandon King is still unfit. Adds that they have a squad of 15-16 players and it's important to give everyone a rest and give opportunities to everyone. Mentions that they need to do better in the Powerplay and need to start well with the bat and is proud of the way the boys showed fight in the last game.

Kiwi skipper, Kane Williamson says that they will bat first because it's the same surface as last time and they want to make the best use of it. Informs that they have one change as Lockie Ferguson has been rested and Michael Bracewell comes in for him. Adds that the game is always moving forward and they have to put on better performances and have to keep working hard. Says that as a side they just want to get better and the last match was a close one.

New Zealand (Playing XI) - Martin Guptill, Devon Conway (WK), Kane Williamson (C), Glenn Phillips, Daryl Mitchell, James Neesham, Michael Bracewell (In for Lockie Ferguson), Mitchell Santner, Ish Sodhi, Tim Southee and Trent Boult.

West Indies (Unchanged XI) - Kyle Mayers, Shamarh Brooks, Nicholas Pooran (C), Devon Thomas (WK), Rovman Powell, Shimron Hetmyer, Jason Holder, Romario Shepherd, Odean Smith, Hayden Walsh and Obed McCoy.
TOSS - New Zealand have won the toss and they will BAT first.

New Zealand on the other hand, can’t put a foot wrong at the moment. Everything their doing is falling in place flfor them. The players who returned into the side after missing out the last two series managed to do well and Williamson will be hungry to continue the good work.
